performanceDiagnostics.scope: Raw instrumented emulator CPU/PSS and stage events; excludes fixture-process CPU/PSS. Not screenshots or device performance acceptance.

jvm.reason: JVM tests have no device UI

scope: Fixed app-experience-pilot diagnostic only: one selected test per API. Other suite tests were not selected and receive no passing status; this cannot replace a full regression. Target Fixture and resident Agent CPU/PSS are measured separately. Startup uses matched Perfetto android_startups time_to_display observations; am start output and frame callbacks do not substitute for TTID. Raw launch, resource and frame reports, bounded compressed traces, failed and unavailable results are retained. Manual accessibility actions and local test-model actions are synthetic; endpoint PSS is not steady-state or peak memory, and received FrameMetrics do not prove presentation. These diagnostics do not establish causal overhead, real-model, physical-device or performance-budget acceptance. Pilot and formal results are separate profiles.
